'''Mine-clans''' were family units on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Averill]]. Each mine-clan operated a [[minehold]]. The [[Jarrad mine-clan]] was a prosperous mine-clan until the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] monopolized sale of [[quadrenium]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]], changing the family's fortunes drastically.<ref name="COI">{{JournalCite|13|Conflict of Interest}}</ref>
